Equation 16.2:
\frac{\mathrm{d}x_{2}}{\mathrm{d}t} =-\frac{rx_{1}}{\theta_{3}}+u_{1}(u_{2}-x_{2})

Symbols (as printed -> plain name to use):
  x_{2}  ->  x2   (substrate concentration)

  u_{1}  ->  u1   (dilution factor)
  u_{2}  ->  u2   (substrate concentration in the feed)
  x_{1}  ->  x1   (measured concentration)
  \theta_{3}  ->  theta3   (yield coefficient relating biomass formation to substrate consumption)
